mainEntity.name: What Is the Difference Between a Cobot Palletizer and a Traditional Robotic Palletizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cobot palletizer uses a collaborative robot, an arm designed for shared workspaces and moderate speeds, in a compact cell with a lower entry cost. A traditional robotic palletizer uses an industrial robot that moves faster, carries heavier loads and runs higher duty cycles. TRFCobot covers lower-speed, high-mix lines; TRFCompact and TRFSpeed cover higher rates and payloads.

mainEntity.name: Can a Compact Palletizer Be Installed in a Brownfield Plant With Limited Space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRFCompact puts an industrial robot in a compact standardized cell designed for brownfield plants and lines where production space has high value, at about 5 to 15 cases per minute and cases up to about 44 lb. TRF validates floor space, reach, pallet positions and operator access with your layout before quoting.
